infoYearT1.evidence_source: [page/6/Text/1] a single item from the manageability subscale was omitted due to an administration error in 2004. As such, 12 items were initially used in the current analysis, measuring the SOC subscales of meaningfulness (four items), manageability (three items) and comprehensibility (five items). Results indicated acceptable item homogeneity for meaningfulness (mean r=0.33 and 0.30) and comprehensibility (mean r=0.38 and 0.35) in 2004 and 2008, respectively.
